summary: Repligen filed an 8-K disclosing closing of private exchange and subscription transactions: it issued $1.0 billion of 0.25% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 under a new indenture with U.S. Bank Trust. About $541.4 million of new notes were exchanged for roughly $456.8 million of its 1.00% 2028 notes, which were canceled, and about $458.6 million was issued for cash. Roughly $143.2 million of 2028 notes remains outstanding. This is a routine debt refinancing/liability management transaction, not a special situation; watch conversion overhang and interest savings.
